title: Pick Up Mod
description: A mod that lets you manually collect items with custom key binds and a toggleable pick up feature.
body:
Adds a customisable item pick up system to prevent accidental pick up from the vanilla system. The feature can be toggled ON or OFF at any time, allowing you to revert back to vanilla pick up whenever you want.

------------------

### Features
- Adds a prompt when looking at an item to pick up:

![Pickup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5bdd534a101f6acef8d312e39c86e056cc41971.gif)

- Adds a toggleable pick up mode:

![Auto Pick Up ON/OFF](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5806a1e95daa10b0abde146a35d2f58a8271047e.gif)

### Key binds
- Press [E] by default to pick up items
- Press [O] by default to toggle on/off vanilla pick up

![Key Binds Controls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8254ed8ab9b86225967776a28f2f19167ac62b24_0.webp)
---------
### More Info
You are free to include this mod in any modpack.
